title: Stalled rollout: new image tag does not exist
description: checkout was updated to a tag that cannot be pulled. The new ReplicaSet is stuck in ImagePullBackOff; the two old pods keep serving. The model should say the rollout is stalled but traffic is still served, and propose a rollback or tag fix without claiming to have done it.
prompt: I deployed a new version of checkout in the shop namespace and the rollout seems stuck. What happened and what should I do?

events.message: Failed to pull image "registry.example.com/shop/checkout:v2.4.1-rc": manifest unknown: tag v2.4.1-rc not found
